title: Bilateral Trade Under Heavy-Tailed Valuations: Minimax Regret without a Variance Bound
abstract: arXiv:2603.06851v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In contextual bilateral trade under full feedback, the posted price does not affect which valuations are observed. We show that in this model such action-independent feedback removes the polynomial adaptation penalty familiar from heavy-tailed bandits: fully parameter-free algorithms attain the oracle minimax $T$-exponents up to logarithmic factors, with no knowledge of the moment order $p \in (1,2)$ or its scale $\sigma_p$, and -- in the nonparametric case -- none of the effective H\"older smoothness $\beta \in (0,1]$. The statistic that makes model selection possible is a paired squared-loss difference, whose noise-square term cancels exactly, leaving noise damped by the candidate gap. The resulting bilateral-trade regret rates are new. Trader valuations have bounded conditional densities and heavy tails -- finite $p$-th moments for some $p \in (1,2)$, with possibly infinite variance. An epoch-based algorithm with truncated m

translated_title: 重尾估值下的双边交易：无方差界约束下的极小极大遗憾
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.06851v4 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：在全反馈下的上下文双边交易问题中，定价行为不会影响所观察到的估值。我们证明在该模型中，这种与行动无关的反馈消除了重尾老虎机问题中常见的多项式自适应惩罚：完全无参数的算法在对数因子范围内即可达到神谕极小极大 T 指数，且无需知道矩阶数 p ∈ (1,2) 或其尺度 σ_p；在非参数情形下，也无需知道有效 Hölder 光滑度 β ∈ (0,1]。使模型选择成为可能的关键统计量是配对平方损失差，其噪声平方项恰好完全抵消，剩余噪声被候选间隙所抑制。由此得到的双边交易遗憾率是全新的。该问题假设交易者估值具有有界条件密度和重尾分布——即对某个 p ∈ (1,2) 具有有限的 p 阶矩，方差可能为无穷大。本文提出一种基于纪元的截断算法……
tldr: 本文证明在上下文双边交易中，与行动无关的全反馈消除了重尾老虎机中的多项式自适应惩罚，提出的完全无参数算法在无需知道矩阶数、尺度或光滑度的情况下即可达到极小极大最优遗憾率。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that action-independent full feedback in contextual bilateral trade removes the polynomial adaptation penalty known from heavy-tailed bandits, with fully parameter-free algorithms achieving oracle minimax regret rates without knowledge of the moment order, scale, or smoothness.
